label: pipeline above 1024 tokens
hypothesis: The batch-1 prefill bulk path serializes ~11.17 ms CPU gather and ~3.50 ms H2D before layers. Route medium prefill to existing bounded pipeline to overlap this work; preserve bulk for decode.
expected_bottleneck: unoverlapped CPU gather and H2D at batch1 length2048
change: Lower default auto-policy bulk cutoff from 4096 to 1024 tokens; no arithmetic/table/precision changes.
decision: Accepted: primary b1 prefill offload latency and absolute gap repeatably reduced; exactness, full matrix, generation and memory gates passed under predeclared uncertainty criteria.
confirmation_run_outcome: R02 benchmark_failed: nonalternating paired design; preserved
limitations: Three independent blocks give wide intervals for small effects. No decode, b8 prefill or generation gain claim.
b16 prefill offload is slower in all three audit pairs (mean 3.393 ms, reduction CI [-9.406,2.619]); unresolved under the declared criterion, preserved as a limitation.
GPU operator profiler unavailable; separate CUDA events cover transfers, CPU traces cover gather and coordination.
Seeded random weights establish equivalence/performance, not language quality.
